description_expanded: Navarre Wanna Leave — A Charming Coastal Retreat Near Navarre Beach Navarre Wanna Leave is a newly built, charming coastal-themed 3-bedroom home designed for comfort, connection, and carefree beach living. Thoughtfully furnished and beautifully styled, this inviting retreat is perfect for families, couples, or small groups ready to experience the best of the Emerald Coast. Comfortable & Coastal Living 3 Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms | Spacious & Family-Friendly Relaxing Primary Suite — The master bedroom features a king bed, Smart TV, and nightstands with built-in charging stations for modern convenience. The private master bath offers a double vanity, a walk-in shower, and elegant touch-activated mirrors for a spa-like feel. Welcoming Guest Bedroom — A queen bed, Smart TV, and nightstands with built-in chargers provide comfort and practicality for additional guests. Cheerful Children’s Room — Two twin beds create the perfect space for kids or extra guests to unwind after a day at the beach. Guest Bathroom — A convenient tub/shower combination serves the guest rooms with ease. Fully Equipped Kitchen & Dining The bright, fully stocked kitchen features brand-new appliances and everything needed to prepare delicious meals in a cozy home setting. With seating for up to 10 guests, it’s ideal for family dinners, holiday gatherings, or casual breakfasts before heading to the shore. Drip coffee maker and Keurig Well-stocked cookware and essentials Open layout for easy entertaining Outdoor Living & Extra Amenities Step outside to the back patio where a propane grill awaits for evening cookouts. The garage includes outdoor games for added fun, and access is conveniently located through the laundry room inside the home. The laundry room offers: Full-size washer and dryer Iron and ironing mat Portable drying rack Everything you need for longer stays or beach-day refreshes. Perfectly Located for Emerald Coast Adventures: Navarre Wanna Leave is ideally situated: 5.3 miles to the sugar-white sands of Navarre Beach 12 miles to Fort Walton Beach 24 miles to Pensacola Beach Take the scenic drive along Navarre Beach toward Pensacola Beach for breathtaking views of the dunes and sparkling Gulf waters. Spend your days snorkeling or reef diving in the clear waters of Navarre Beach, rent paddleboards or kayaks, or launch your kayak from the bay side. Beach service vendors offer chair and umbrella rentals, and local providers offer golf cart rentals (for use on the beach road only, not the main highway). Bike rentals are also available for rentals on Navarre beach Nearby conveniences include Publix, Walmart, and Winn-Dixie, along with a variety of restaurants and charming gift shops. Designed with family-friendly comfort and thoughtful coastal touches throughout. Non- Smoking Minimum rental age 25 Whether you’re soaking up the sun, exploring the water, or simply relaxing in this beautifully appointed coastal home, Navarre Wanna Leave may just make you never want to leave at all. 🌊
